notes: Bootstrap baseline: the committed numbers are intentionally empty until the first full coverage run on a healthy main.

Regenerate with: node scripts/coverage/write-baseline.mjs --format lcov --report apps/web/coverage/lcov.info --root "$PWD" --stack web --tool "vitest (istanbul v8)" --out apps/web/coverage-baseline.json
While `bootstrap` is true the coverage workflow is report-only and does not fail the build.
